s.en: show / configure per-selector trust and trust order of the application priority table of the DCB (Data Center Bridging) subsystem

syn: dcb [ OPTIONS ] apptrust { COMMAND | help } ⏎ dcb apptrust show dev DEV [ order ] ⏎ dcb apptrust set dev DEV [ order SEL-LIST ] ⏎ SEL-LIST := [ SEL-LIST ] SEL ⏎ SEL := { ethtype | stream-port | dgram-port | port | dscp | pcp }
